title: The Open Window
summary: A nervous visitor hears a clever young girl's ghost story and gets a shock he will never forget.

source.author: Saki (H. H. Munro)
source.note: Retold from the plot in new B2 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from the original text.

license: Adaptation CC BY 4.0 Lexkite; original story in the public domain

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: a large country house window open to a green lawn at dusk, a young girl sitting in a chair, three hunters far away in the mist, no text

chapters.title: A Nervous Visitor
sentences: Framton Nuttel had come to the countryside because his doctor had told him to rest.
His nerves were weak, and he needed quiet, fresh air, and no excitement at all.
His sister had given him several letters of introduction to the people living nearby.
On the first afternoon he visited Mrs Sappleton, a lady he had never met.
He was kept waiting in the sitting room by her fifteen-year-old niece, who greeted him politely.
The girl asked whether he knew many people in the area, and he admitted that he knew nobody.
She wondered aloud whether he knew anything about her aunt, and he replied that he did not.
Then she pointed to a large window that stood wide open onto the lawn.
It was a warm October day, so he thought it was a strange thing to remark upon.
She lowered her voice and said that the window had a sad and terrible story behind it.

quiz.q: Why had Framton come to the countryside?
quiz.explain: His doctor told him to rest because his nerves were weak.
The fifteen-year-old niece greeted him while he waited.

quiz.q: What did the girl point at?
quiz.explain: She pointed to a window standing wide open onto the lawn.

chapters.title: The Ghosts at Dusk
sentences: The girl explained that, exactly three years earlier, her aunt's husband and two brothers had gone hunting.
They had walked out through that window and never returned, because they had disappeared in a dangerous marsh.
Her poor aunt still kept the window open each evening, hoping that they would come home.
She added that they usually walked in at dusk, with a white coat and a little dog.
Framton shivered and tried to change the subject to something more cheerful.
Mrs Sappleton then entered the room, apologised for being late, and chatted happily about the hunting.
She hoped the men would bring a few birds home for dinner, and she kept glancing at the window.
Framton, horrified, tried to explain that doctors had advised him to avoid any shock.
Suddenly his hostess smiled and said that her husband and brothers were coming back.
He turned and saw three figures crossing the lawn in the fading light, with a dog beside them.
He grabbed his hat and ran out of the house in panic, and the niece calmly invented another story.

quiz.q: According to the girl, what happened to the three men?
quiz.explain: She said they disappeared in a dangerous marsh.

quiz.q: How did Framton react at the end?
quiz.explain: He grabbed his hat and ran out of the house.

quiz.q: What is the best description of the niece?
quiz.explain: She invented a story and then calmly made up another one.
